blurb:
Explore the enchanting streets of Old Quebec on a private walking tour designed for travelers who want more than just a checklist of landmarks. Led by a knowledgeable local guide, this experience combines the city's most iconic attractions—including Château Frontenac, Dufferin Terrace, Place Royale, Petit Champlain, and the historic fortifications—with fascinating stories that bring Quebec City's 400-year history to life.
Unlike larger group tours, this private experience allows for a more relaxed pace, personalized attention, and opportunities to ask questions along the way. Discover hidden corners, charming alleys, and lesser-known treasures such as Rue du Trésor, an outdoor art gallery beloved by locals and visitors alike. Whether it's your first visit or a return trip, you'll gain a deeper appreciation for the culture, architecture, and unique French heritage that make Quebec City one of North America's most captivating destinations.
